::: about-me-text
Hello! I am David, a Ph.D. student in Political Science at the [Graduate School of Economic and Social Sciences](https://www.uni-mannheim.de/gess/) at the University of Mannheim. As part of my PhD, I worked as a research associate at the [Chair of Comparative Government](https://www.sowi.uni-mannheim.de/en/debus/), teaching seminars on data collection, transformation, and visualization using R. I also worked as a PhD Trainee at the European Central Bank's EU Institutions and Fora division.

My research explores how political and societal transformations, such as climate change, digitalization, or EU cohesion policy affect **(intra-)party competition**, **political behavior**, and **political communication**. Methodologically, I draw on a range of approaches, with a focus on **computational text analysis** of parliamentary speeches, press releases, and social media data. In my dissertation, I study how parties, politicians, and citizens deal with the consequences of **climate change**.

Feel free to reach out via e-mail, Bluesky, or LinkedIn if you are interested in my research or collaboration.
:::
